[[File:TrandoshanExplorer-EotEBtR.png|thumb|Most reptilian species, such as the Trandoshans, were ectothermic.]]
{{Quote|Maybe I shouldn't have used the term cold-blooded. It's more correct to say that the creature is an ectotherm. You, on the other hand, are an endotherm&mdash;sometimes called a warm-blooded animal.|[[4B-X]]|<ref name="SWSA">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Journey Across Planet X]]''</ref>}}
'''Ectothermy''' was the physiological ability of some creatures to maintain their body temperatures by absorbing heat from their environment. It was also colloquially referred to as '''cold-bloodedness''', although that term could be misleading&mdash;at least [[Stuart Zissu|one individual]] interpreted it literally, thinking that an ectothermic creature's [[Blood/Legends|blood]] was frozen solid. The opposite of ectothermy was [[endothermy]]. A vast majority of [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]],<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> such as the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> or the [[Unidentified flying lizard|flying lizards]] of [[Da'nor]], were cold-blooded organisms,<ref name="SWSA" /> although there were exceptions such as the [[Ssi-ruu]]k<ref name="TEGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> or the [[duuvhal]]s.<ref name="Zeev">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010517d_duuvhal&c=rpg|text=Meet Zeev, a Pet Duuvhal}}</ref> When the weather was too cold for his or her taste, an ectothermic being became torpid and experienced a decrease of his or her intellectual capacities.<ref name="The Paradise Snare">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> If no external source of heat was provided in time, that situation could degenerate gradually until [[Death/Legends|death]] ensued.<ref name="SWSA" /> To,conserve their energy and avoid getting cold during the night, some species like the [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]] insulated themselves in huddled groups.<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
